levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبي ليلى
عبد الله بن عكيم أبي معبد الجهني

notes: «عيسى، أخيه» gives Isa as the brother of Muhammad; «أخيه» describes the same man and is not a second link.
«عبد الله بن عكيم أبي معبد الجهني» is one man (a kunya and a nisba after the name).
«فقلنا» has no named speaker and is scene only; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
The compiler's remarks after the matn are left out.

fixes.reason: HKG's route for the same report names Ibn Yasar at the third link; the text names Ibn Abi Layla there.
